# ScreenHire

> ScreenHire is an applicant tracking system (ATS) for small hiring teams. It detects bots, impersonators and
> AI-generated or copy-paste job applications, and explains every flag in plain language with a suggested next step.
> It never rejects candidates automatically.

## What ScreenHire does

- Applicant tracking with per-job hiring workflows built from reusable templates.
- Applicant integrity checks at the application stage: where the application came from, the documents submitted, and
  the screening answers — reported as evidence and counter-evidence, never as a verdict.
- One-click posting to a careers page, Google for Jobs and job boards, and one-click removal.
- A public API for integrations.

## Principles

- Evidence, not verdicts; a person always decides.
- Candidates are told what is checked before anything is collected, and can opt out of typing signals if they use
  assistive technology.
- No emotion recognition, no biometric profiling, no scraping.
